prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: illustrated mobile hotpot tile-puzzle background, portrait 720:1520 aspect ratio.
Primary request: Create a new richly painted background called 锦绣朱楼, using the two supplied images solely as composition and rendering references. Preserve their exact tall composition and dense edge decoration while changing the environment into an ornate Chinese palace feast alcove.
Composition invariants: tall portrait 720:1520. Decorative header drapes and arch occupy top 0–14% of height. A very large EMPTY light warm ivory playing field fills x=10–90%, y=16–73.5%; keep the entire middle clear and clean with only a very subtle paper texture. The center must be suitable for overlaying game UI and food tiles. Decorative structure only at the far left and right edges, no center obstruction. Straight horizontal wooden tabletop horizon begins precisely at y=73.5%; tabletop fills the bottom. Large copper hotpot partially cropped at bottom-left, chopsticks holder and tiny props clustered at bottom-right. No tray.
Scene: rich scarlet brocade drapes embroidered with subdued gold botanical patterns; carved vermilion wood edging and warm brass fittings; glowing red-and-gold palace lanterns at the top corners, peony branches restricted to the sides, delicate carved wood columns. Warm white ivory center. Deep red lacquer and rosewood table, a lacquer chopstick holder, small red silk corner at bottom-right. Elegant sumptuous palace-feast identity, visibly different from green bamboo reference.
Style/medium: polished painterly casual mobile game art, detailed illustrated tactile fabric and wood and metal, rich but harmonious materials, luminous warm light, appetizing copper hotpot, soft shadows, immersive and finely rendered. Match reference craftsmanship and scale. Not flat vector, not photorealism.
Text: none.
Constraints: NO words, letters, logos, text, watermark, phone frame, food tile cards, buttons, UI controls, trays, game boards, humans or characters. Keep the center EMPTY. Preserve source aspect ratio, tabletop height, and prop scale.
